description: This Java class implements the JournalEntryAggregationWriterService, providing methods to insert and rollback journal entry summaries and tracking data in a financial application, specifically related to journal entry aggregation during job execution.

classes.name: JournalEntryAggregationWriterServiceImpl
classes.description: A service class that manages the persistence of journal entry summaries and tracking data, including inserting new records and rolling back existing ones based on job execution ID.

methods.name: insertJournalEntrySummaryBatch
methods.description: Converts a list of summary data into entity objects and saves them in batch to the repository.

methods.name: insertJournalEntryTracking
methods.description: Logs and saves journal entry tracking data for a specific job execution.

methods.name: rollbackJournalEntrySummary
methods.description: Deletes journal entry summaries associated with a specific job execution to facilitate rollback.

methods.name: rollbackJournalEntryTracking
methods.description: Deletes journal entry tracking data associated with a specific job execution for rollback purposes.

methods.name: saveJournalEntryTracking
methods.description: Creates and saves a new JournalEntryAggregationTracking entity based on DTO data.

methods.name: convertToJournalEntrySummary
methods.description: Converts DTO data into a JournalEntrySummary entity object.
